memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow-up of known hypothyroidism, fatigue and weight gain.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84, weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Pulse regular, no thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Hypothyroidism uncontrolled, TSH likely elevated.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting TSH and free T4. Continue levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Return if worsening fatigue, palpitations, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Review of thyroid labs, persistent mild fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 27.4 (obese).
IMPRESSION: TSH elevated, free T4 low – inadequate levothyroxine dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Recheck TSH in 6 weeks. Return if new palpitations, tremor, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow-up, patient feels better.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80, weight 77 kg, BMI 26.9 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: TSH now within target range on 75 mcg levothyroxine.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current dose. Repeat TSH in 6 months. Return if weight change >5 kg, palpitations, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel less tired and my constipation has improved since increasing the thyroxine.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Annual review, asymptomatic.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/78, weight 76.5 kg, BMI 27.1 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg. Lipids and glucose checked as per annual screening.
ARRANGEMENTS: Offered influenza vaccine; patient accepted and received today. Repeat fasting lipid profile and fasting glucose in 1 year. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, or unexplained weight loss.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L (3.9-5.5) – borderline; repeat in 3 months. Total cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2 desirable). HDL 1.2 mmol/L (>1.0 good). LDL 2.9 mmol/L (<2.6 near target). Triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7 normal). TSH 4.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4 13.5 pmol/L (10.0-23.0).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-02-15 10:30 with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for review of borderline glucose and lipid results.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Review of borderline fasting glucose and lipids.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/76, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.9 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Impaired fasting glucose; lipids near target. No overt diabetes.
ARRANGEMENTS: Advise lifestyle modification – reduced refined carbs, daily walk 30 min. Repeat fasting glucose in 3 months. Continue levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Return if polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting glucose 5.4 mmol/L (3.9-5.5) – still borderline. TSH 4.3 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4 13.4 pmol/L (10.0-23.0).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow-up, stable.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/74, weight 75.5 kg, BMI 26.8 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Borderline glucose persistent; consider metformin if worsens. Thyroid stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat fasting glucose in 6 months. Continue levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Return if new symptoms suggestive of diabetes, chest pain, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Final review within study window.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/72, weight 75 kg, BMI 26.5 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Patient euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Glucose still borderline, lipids acceptable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current therapy. Annual influenza vaccine due next autumn. Return if any red‑flag symptoms: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.
